metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over South Los Angeles, California lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) concentration over South Los Angeles, California, comparing October 1-23, 2021 with the same period in 2019 and 2018. This requires: 1. Data: I should use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) which provides tropospheric NO2 column density 2. Location: Need to define South Los Angeles area as a polygon 3. Time periods: Oct 1-23 for 2018, 2019, and 2021 4. Analysis: Calculate mean NO2 concentration for each period and compare if 2021 is lower than both 2018 and 2019 5. Data quality: Check for empty collections and valid pixels I'll use the 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' band from Sentinel-5P. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define South Los Angeles geometry const southLA = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-118.35, 33.95], [-118.35, 34.00], [-118.20, 34.00], [-118.20, 33.95], [-118.35, 33.95] ]); // Function to get NO2 data for a given year async function getNO2Data(year) { const startDate = year + '-10-01'; const endDate = year + '-10-23'; const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(southLA) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const count = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Images: ${count}`); if (count === 0) return {mean: null, pixelCount: 0, valid: false}; const meanImage = collection.mean(); // Check pixel count const pixelStats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southLA, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = pixelStats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); if (pixelCount === 0) return {mean: null, pixelCount: 0, valid: false}; // Calculate mean NO2 concentration const meanStats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southLA, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanValue = meanStats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); return { mean: meanValue, pixelCount: pixelCount, valid: meanValue !== null && !isNaN(meanValue) }; } // Get data for all three years const data2018 = await getNO2Data('2018'); const data2019 = await getNO2Data('2019'); const data2021 = await getNO2Data('2021'); // Check for data issues if (!data2018.valid || !data2019.valid || !data2021.valid) { if (data2018.pixelCount === 0 || data2019.pixelCount === 0 || data2021.pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in one or more years"); console.log("C2"); return; } console.log("Calculation failed for one or more years"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Print results console.log(`2018 NO2: ${data2018.mean.toFixed(6)} mol/m²`); console.log(`2019 NO2: ${data2019.mean.toFixed(6)} mol/m²`); console.log(`2021 NO2: ${data2021.mean.toFixed(6)} mol/m²`); console.log(`2021 < 2019: ${data2021.mean < data2019.mean}`); console.log(`2021 < 2018: ${data2021.mean < data2018.mean}`); // Determine answer if (data2021.mean < data2019.mean && data2021.mean < data2018.mean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
